translations.web: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
translations.bsb: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
translations.kjv: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
translations.asv: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.
